sentences.en: As far as English is concerned, nobody can beat me.
sentences.zh: 至于英语方面，没人能超过我。

sentences.en: That is all right, so far as I am concerned.
Granting that it is true, it does not concern me.
sentences.zh: 承认那是真的，但这与我无关。
